We need to output JSONL (JSON Lines) format: each line is a JSON object representing a row, with keys from header and values from row.

We need to respond only with the table (i.e., the JSONL lines) and then final answer line.

...

Make sure to preserve values exactly as given (no extra spaces). The title values have spaces and pipes; they appear as "Rail | Service Frequ". The scope values: "This program include". Probably they truncated but keep as is.

Thus JSONL lines accordingly.

Now output each line.
